License: Apache License, Version 2.0

The vendored Tiny architecture and CPU line decoder are derived from the
upstream files above. The local checkpoint is the upstream
models/mlsd_tiny_512_fp32.pth file, SHA-256
3f2323cfb9faec5a0ef2454c4f68998da21a9f1b7918ce89b85886628b750b94.

Local modifications: focused module boundaries, type annotations, explicit
CPU-only tensor validation, and removal of the upstream CUDA-only execution
path. The network topology and output decoding arithmetic are retained.
